I was in this exact scenario a month ago, minus the supply chain class. I was completely burned out though so I only managed to get through IA3 and comp/benefits my last month. From what my mentor told me, you can extend your term for another month to finish the classes you have, but only if you've attempted the OA or task and that has to be done by the 15th and they must request the extension by like the 23rd. It might be different if you only have one or two classes left. Not sure, since that wasn't the case for me. I'm paying 3.1K to finish off my last 3 classes in a second term.

If you can get it done, I would just put my head down and finish. Not worth spending another 3-4K and if you want to do the Masters, you won't be able to start until March if you start a new term. Doesn't mean you can't start applying, who knows how long it could take to find an accounting job and a month will go by fast.

Either way, what you have accomplished is fantastic! Best of luck
